Name: Naisarg Halvadiya
summary: Applied AI Engineer with 4+ years of software engineering experience and hands-on expertise in Generative AI, multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, LLM evaluation, vector search and machine learning. Built production-grade AI systems using LangGraph, LangChain, Claude, Ollama, FastAPI and PyTorch, including multi-agent healthcare workflows, enterprise RAG applications and predictive analytics solutions. Strong background in backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and translating AI research into scalable business products.

work_experience.title: Applied AI Engineer
highlights: Designed and developed AI-ready data architectures and backend services using Go/Gin, PostgreSQL and AWS EC2 to support scalable multi-tenant applications.
Built and maintained structured datasets from competition scoresheets, judging feedback and sensory evaluation records, enabling future LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines and analytics workflows.
Architected tenant-isolated APIs, authentication flows and data access controls to ensure secure multi-club data segregation and scalability.
Developed data models and ETL processes to standardize unstructured judging data into formats suitable for machine learning and AI-powered insights.

Evaluated and integrated retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search and LLM-based analytics into the platform roadmap, including recommendation, knowledge-retrieval and reputation-scoring features.

work_experience.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
highlights: Mentored 500+ students in full-stack development and data science fundamentals.
Guided student projects implementing industry standards for testing, deployment, and analysis.
Created automated grading systems reducing evaluation time by 50%.

work_experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Resolved critical performance and stability issues in a Node.js SaaS platform serving 5,000+ daily enterprise users by identifying event-loop blocking, database connection-pool exhaustion and inefficient SQL queries on indexed columns. Refactored data-processing workflows, optimized Redis cache invalidation and restored index-scan query execution, reducing retrieval latency by 30% and supporting renewal of a $1M enterprise contract.

Reduced production defects by 90% by designing and implementing a GitLab CI/CD pipeline with 70+ automated Cypress integration tests. Established automated quality gates, standardized Git workflows and mentored a 10-engineer team on testing and deployment best practices.
Analyzed production incidents to root cause and built monitoring and alerting systems, making preemptive system changes to prevent recurrence and improve platform reliability.
Developed RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js, allowing easy integration with internal analytics platforms and enterprise-level client applications.
Improved PostgreSQL performance through query optimization, indexing and schema modifications, delivering faster reporting and more responsive application behavior.

work_experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Led a 7-engineer team to build a centralized performance-management platform for 30+ teams, implementing RBAC to secure sensitive employee data and supporting 25+ concurrent enterprise pilot programs.

Developed a logistic-regression churn prediction model that identified at-risk pilot accounts using product-usage and engagement signals, enabling proactive customer-success interventions and contributing to a 35% pilot-to-enterprise conversion rate (~$350K in new annual recurring revenue).

Built and deployed an NLP-based sentiment analysis pipeline that processed 10,000+ employee feedback records to automatically extract themes, trends and insights, reducing performance-review cycle time by 65% and saving approximately 20 hours of manual HR reporting effort per month.
Implemented full-stack features using Angular, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL to support performance management workflows in different business units and increased user adoption in pilot teams.
Automated data ingestion and reporting using FastAPI and Python services, improving data accuracy and reducing operational overhead across business units.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Financial Analyst
